Friends are other player characters that you can keep track of in the Friends List. When a Friend enters the game, you get notified as a system message, usually in yellow text. The /friend command allows one to add the target to the Friends List directly.

.]] Default pane and first tab at the bottom left of the Socials window that lists friends that you track in the game. Sometimes called the "Friends pane." Frenzies are a large, piranha-like fish, found throughout both Azeroth. They usually appear as hostile aquatic beasts, though the Loch Frenzy can also be fished for. Frenzies also appear in Outland, but only in the presence of the naga, making it possible the naga took the creatures with them from Azeroth. A variation known as deep sea frenzies are native to Nazjatar and have long been a staple food of the naga. On the other hand, giant swarms of deep sea frenzies are apparently horrific things that the naga and ankoan alike fear, their numbers blotting out all light and devouring all unhidden flesh.

The Frenzyheart Tribe faction is a primitive tribe of wolvars located in Sholazar Basin. Driven from their lands by the Scourge prior to the war against the Lich King, this fierce tribe of wolvar stumbled upon Sholazar Basin, where they intend to make their new home. According to Muradin Bronzebeard, they are rather vague about where their original lands were, as apparently their names for everything in Northrend are different from the others races. While their members are some of the calmest wolvar in Northrend, their aggressive nature has put them at odds with the various gorloc tribes known collectively as the Oracles. Frenzyheart Hill is the village of the Frenzyheart Tribe of wolvar in Sholazar Basin. It is a village of their typical low, round dwellings atop a hill that's been named after them. They founded it in the region after being driven from their lands by the Scourge, prior to the war against the Lich King. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard visited Frenzyheart Hill and the wolvar there were happy to see Brann among them, as they welcomed him like a long-lost friend, and even more remarkable, they joked with him about also being friends with their sworn enemies, the Oracles. Freya is one of the titanic Keepers. She resided in the Temple of Life in the Storm Peaks until Keeper Loken rebelled against the titan-forged. Yogg-Saron took control of her and made her lay dormant inside the greenery of Ulduar. Freya left behind an avatar in Sholazar Basin to protect it as a fail-safe if she were to be unavailable to the land. She has always been associated with Life and its protection.

Freehold is a dungeon in Battle for Azeroth. It is located in the southernmost point of Tiragarde Sound. It is entered from near Castaway Point. Frightened Gladestalkers are elite shadowstalkers located in the Mistveil Tangle in Ardenweald. Unlike the Fog-Frenzied Gladestalkers, they have not been driven mad by the mist and instead run about erratically in fear.
Frost Resistance Totem is a totem that increases Frost Resistance of all raid members within 30 yards.

Prior to patch 4.0.1, Frost Ward was a mage spell that would cast a shield on the caster to absorb frost damage. The shield would last 30 seconds or until the given amount of damage was absorbed, whichever came first. Frost Ward was self-cast only. Since Patch 4.0.1, Frost Ward has been replaced with Mage Ward which is a similar spell that also blocks Fire and Arcane damage. Previously, Frost Ward (Rank 5) could have been trained at level 60 from Tome of Frost Ward V; a random drop from pre-TBC high level dungeons, raid bosses and outdoor world bosses.

From the Desk of Lord Victor Nefarius is a note that players receive from if they kill him more than five hours after activating the quest Nefarius's Corruption, part of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain.
Frost Protection Potions will protect the imbiber from all cold related damage. It will not stop any extra effects, such as slowing effects.

The Frost Tiger Blade is a two-handed sword which is cold-forged instead of being forged by fire. Its keen edge allows it to perform devestating strikes and the chilling blade will slow its victim in their tracks.

Frost Dagger Pass is the passage way right under the bridge of Snowfall Graveyard. Currently, it holds nothing of importance. However, it might have been a useful passage way before the avalanche that cut off most of Winterax Hold. Currently, the passage is used by NPC cavalries to pass through Field of Strife if the players summon them.
Frost Wolf Bloodhounds are wolves found in Alterac Valley. They cannot be tamed by hunters.
Frost Wolves are level 50-61 wolves found in Alterac Valley. They have a relationship with the Frostwolf clan that inhabits the valley.

Frost revenants are revenants based around the elements of "air" and "cold". Frost revenants are the cold opposites of fire revenants. The two types do not get along, and the only thing they hate more than anything else is each other. The creature is seemingly humanoid, but rides on a ball of blue-colored energy rather than walking on two feet. A frost revenant wears flowing dark blue robes under scale mail armor and carries a heavy mace and large metal shield emblazoned with a single white-colored image of an eyeball.
